matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the same LayerCast method description in Section 4 and points to the exact inconsistency: the text claims no upcasting to FP32 at runtime while elsewhere stating computations occur in full FP32 precision. This directly detects the contradictory method description about when weights are cast, which is the core defect in gt_id 1.

Finding 2 discusses a contradiction in Appendix H about deterministic casting versus stochastic fluctuations, which is a different locus from gt_id 2's defect in Section 2 (Preliminaries) about random seeds, greedy decoding, and computation order. The material and specific inconsistency are different, so R1 (locus) is not satisfied.
